by the American Board of Neuro Linguistic Programming (ABNLP)

😅 𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗲'𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗯𝗶𝘁:

This is NOT one of those trainings where you sit in a hotel ballroom, nod along, get a nice certificate, and go back to being exactly the same person on Monday.

This one messes with you. In a good way.

You'll laugh. You might cry (we've seen it happen - bring tissues, thank us later). You'll definitely have a moment where you go *"𝒐𝒉 𝒏𝒐... 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑰'𝒗𝒆 𝒃𝒆𝒆𝒏 𝒅𝒐𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒇𝒐𝒓 10 𝒚𝒆𝒂𝒓𝒔... 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕'𝒔 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒂𝒄𝒕𝒖𝒂𝒍 𝒑𝒓𝒐𝒃𝒍𝒆𝒎."

That's the point. That's when the real work - and the real magic - begins.

- Professionally - you become the person in the room who can read what's *really* going on, influence, lead and take charge of  conversations instead of surviving them.
- As a coach - you leave with an actual toolkit, not just theory. You can start coaching, mentoring, or facilitating almost immediately - because we train you to use this, not just merely have framed certificates. 

🌍 𝗔𝗻𝗱 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲'𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀::

Every person you help after this... helps someone else.

Your calmer version shows up for your kids differently. Your client walks away lighter and treats their team better. Your coachee finally breaks a pattern they've carried for 20 years - and stops passing it down to their own children.

One person, done properly, changes a whole ripple of people they'll never even meet.

🤝 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹 𝘆𝗼𝘂:

Most certification programmes end the moment the training does. You get a certificate, a handshake, and a "good luck out there."

We don't do that.

You get lifelong group coaching sessions with us. For life. (Not a typo.)

Because learning NLP in a 7-days is one thing. Actually using it when real life throws chaos at you six months later? That's where most people quietly give up - alone, with no one to ask "wait, how do I apply this here?"

Not on our watch.

- Corporate leaders tired of "managing" people instead of actually leading them
- HR and L&D folks who want tools that work, not another framework that dies in a slide deck
- Educators & Trainers
- Students above 16 years old
- Sales teams
- Parents
- Those wanting to work on their relationships
- Those who has said enough is enough to their childhood trauma
- Aspiring coaches who want to build a real practice, not just a nice Instagram bio
- Anyone who's tired of being triggered by the same 3 people at every family gathering

Who it's NOT for: people who want to stay exactly the same and just complain about it more eloquently.
